name: Ticket to Ride Legacy: Legends of the West
Chichén Itzá
bgg_comment: When appropriating a culture, it's good form to respect it. This game misses the mark by mixing in elements that have no place in Maya mythology, like triceratops, 4-leaf clovers, and rubies. The Maya have a rich and deeply symbolic mythology that spans thousands of years, filled with fascinating creatures and deities like the K'iche' Hero Twins, Wayob, and Camazotz. Instead, the game opts for random, misplaced symbols that feel careless and uninformed. If you're going to draw inspiration from a culture, taking the time to understand and honor it should be the minimum standard.
